# Aurora

> Aurora compiles Beamer LaTeX decks (.tex) into single-file, manim-style animated HTML presentations. It supports written equations, animated plots with value trackers, histograms, equation morphs, and organic-chemistry mechanisms (SMILES molecules, curly arrows, mechanism transforms). Existing Beamer decks compile unchanged: the full overlay syntax, \input files, sections and outlines, theorems, tables, highlighted listings, PDF figures, footnotes, BibTeX bibliographies and TikZ.

CLI: `aurora build|serve|check|pdf|video|snapshot|init|reference`. All machine-facing commands accept `--json`. In the browser: speaker view with notes, timer and next-step preview; phone remote (`serve --remote`); pen; autoplay; reduced motion.

## Docs

- [Agent skill](skills/aurora-slides/SKILL.md): drop-in skill for Claude Code and other agents
